title: NOC Engineer - Level 2 (L2)
description:
Position Overview 
 The NOC L2 Engineer is responsible for providing advanced technical support, monitoring, troubleshooting and maintenance of enterprise IT infrastructure and network environments. The role involves handling escalated incidents from Level 1 support, identifying root causes, resolving complex technical issues and ensuring the stability, availability and performance of customer infrastructure.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in networking and IT infrastructure, with the ability to troubleshoot across multiple technology domains. Exposure to cybersecurity technologies will be considered an added advantage. Key Responsibilities 

 Network Operations & Troubleshooting 
 Monitor, maintain and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, WLAN and VPN environments. Troubleshoot routing, switching, VLANs, connectivity, DNS, DHCP and network performance issues. Support and configure network devices such as routers, switches, wireless controllers and access points. Handle Level 2 escalations from the NOC L1 team and ensure timely resolution of incidents. Perform network health checks, performance monitoring and preventive maintenance. Assist in implementing network changes, upgrades and configuration improvements. 

 IT Infrastructure Support 
 Provide Level 2 support for enterprise IT infrastructure, including servers, virtualization platforms and storage environments. Troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy and related infrastructure services. Support virtualized environments such as VMware and Hyper-V. Assist with server deployment, patching, upgrades, backup monitoring and infrastructure maintenance. Troubleshoot hardware, operating system and infrastructure-related issues across customer environments. Support Microsoft 365 and other enterprise infrastructure platforms, where applicable. 

 Incident & Escalation Management 
 Manage technical escalations from L1 support and take ownership of incidents until resolution. Analyse recurring incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA) and recommend corrective actions. Ensure incidents and service requests are properly documented in the ticketing system. Adhere to SLA requirements and ensure timely communication with customers and internal teams. Escalate critical incidents to L3, vendors or relevant technical teams when required. Maintain accurate technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures and incident reports. 

 Security Support Added Advantage 
 Assist in troubleshooting and supporting network security devices, including firewalls and VPN solutions. Provide support for firewall rule reviews, connectivity troubleshooting and basic security configuration changes, subject to approved procedures. Support security technologies such as endpoint protection, IDS/IPS and security monitoring solutions. Assist in identifying potential security incidents and coordinate escalation to the relevant security team. Participate in security patching, vulnerability remediation and infrastructure hardening activities. 

 Monitoring, Reporting & Documentation 
 Monitor infrastructure availability, performance and alerts using NOC monitoring tools. Identify potential service disruptions and take proactive action to prevent incidents. Maintain network diagrams, infrastructure records, configuration backups and technical documentation. Prepare incident reports, operational updates and maintenance reports as required. Coordinate with vendors, internal engineering teams and customer IT teams for troubleshooting and service restoration. 

 Required Qualifications & Experience 
 Bachelor's degree or diploma in IT, Computer Science, Networking or a related field. 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Network Operations, IT Infrastructure Support or a similar technical support role. Strong practical knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs and network troubleshooting. Experience supporting Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualization and core IT infrastructure services. Familiarity with network and infrastructure monitoring tools. Experience working in a NOC, IT operations or managed services environment. Good understanding of incident management, escalation procedures and SLA-driven support operations. 

 Preferred Technical Skills 

 Technology Area Required Knowledge Networking TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing, Switching, DNS, DHCP, VPN Network Vendors Cisco, Aruba, HPE or similar Firewall & Security Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto or similar advantage Server Infrastructure Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy Virtualization VMware vSphere / ESXi, Hyper-V Monitoring ConnectWise, NinjaOne, Auvik, Nagios or similar Backup Veeam or similar backup solutions Cloud Basic exposure to Azure /AWS or other cloud platforms advantage ITSM ServiceNow, ManageEngine, Jira Service Management or similar Certifications (Preferred) 
 CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) CompTIA Network+ Microsoft Windows Server / Azure certifications VMware certifications Fortinet NSE / FCP, Palo Alto or other firewall certifications ITIL Foundation 

 Key Competencies 
 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work independently and manage technical escalations. Customer-oriented approach with good communication skills. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Ability to work under pressure in an SLA-driven environment. Good documentation and reporting skills. Willingness to work in shifts, on-call rotations or extended hours when required. 

 Reporting Structure 

 Department: Technical Services / Network Operations Position : NOC Engineer Level 2 Reports To: NOC Manager / Technical Services Manager Level : Technical Support L2 Primary Focus Networking & IT Infrastructure Security Exposure Preferred / Added Advantage Role focus: Recruit a strong infrastructure and networking L2 engineer rather than a purely monitoring-based NOC operator, with security knowledge as a desirable supplementary skill. Note : This vacancy is for Kochi office and prefers candidatesfrom Kerala.

title: Backend Quality Engineer Automation
description:
Backend Quality Engineer Automation - J51023 
 Role & responsibilities About the role :
Extend an existing backend API automation framework built with TypeScript, Node.js, and
Playwright Test. You will develop REST and GraphQL tests from assigned projects, user
stories, and test cases, keep smoke and regression runs healthy in GitHub Actions, and use
Allure reports to explain failures. You will work with the Automation QE Lead and the
functional QA team. Framework design, tool selection, and the automation roadmap stay
with the lead.
What you will do:
• Develop new API test suites, helpers, and fixtures in TypeScript from assigned projects,
user stories, and test cases.
• Write and maintain automated REST and GraphQL tests for success, error, and edge
cases inside the existing framework.
• Reuse and extend API clients, validation helpers, fixtures, and Playwright configuration.
Follow the patterns already in the repo.
• Check status codes, headers, authentication, response schemas, and nested JSON
fields. Confirm persisted data when a test needs it.
• Run smoke and regression suites, read Allure reports, and share results with the
functional QA team.
• When a test fails, decide whether the cause is the product, the test code, the test data,
or the environment. If it is a product bug, work with functional QA to get it logged.
• Update scripts when APIs or test data change, and keep regression suites current.
• Maintain GitHub Actions workflows for smoke and regression.
• Use environment variables and secrets correctly for local and CI runs.
• Commit test code to Git and take part in code reviews for automation scripts.
• Document how to set up the framework, run tests, and add a test or fixture, so others
on the team can follow the same steps.
• Help functional QE run the scripts on their machines when asked.
Required
• Bachelor`s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or
equivalent practical experience.
• 56 years in quality engineering, including hands-on backend API automation.
• Solid TypeScript and working experience with Node.js.
• Experience with Playwright Test for API automation: assertions, fixtures, hooks, and
configuration.
• Experience testing REST and GraphQL: HTTP methods, headers, token-based
authentication, queries, mutations, and variables.
• Experience checking JSON response schemas and nested fields.
• Experience with Git, GitHub Actions, and a reporting tool such as Allure.
• Able to take assigned stories and test cases through to merged, reviewed automation in
an Agile team.
 Good to have :
• Media, entertainment, or sports: live streaming, VOD, authenticated playback, replays,
search, recommendations.
• Checking data in MongoDB or DynamoDB.
• Zod or JSONPath.
• GraphQL persisted queries and hash mismatches.
• Playwright UI flows to create test data, and Trace Viewer to debug failures.
• Postman for manual API checks while you learn a service.
• Jira and Confluence
